items.name: North District Token
items.description: A brass token from the Financial Quarter. Proof you walked their halls.

items.name: South District Token
items.description: An iron cog from the Industrial Zone. Heavy with meaning.

items.name: East District Token
items.description: A carved wooden leaf from the Residential Gardens. Smells of rain.

items.name: West District Token
items.description: A neon-glass shard from the Entertainment District. It glows faintly.

items.name: Old Charter Fragment
items.description: A torn page from Oakhaven's founding document.

items.name: Underground Map
items.description: Shows passages connecting all four districts.

items.name: Keeper's Letter
items.description: A message from the first mayor, sealed but unread.

items.name: District Beacon
items.description: Marks the center of each district.

items.name: City Lantern
items.description: Lights the way through dark passages.

items.name: Memory Shard
items.description: Contains a fragment of the city's forgotten history.
